player_prompt.intro:
Ou ap jwe Countdown numbers game!
Bijè: Konbine nimewo itilize +, -, *, / pou rive nan target.
Fòmat aksyon: [i j op] kote i, j se endis ak op se operasyon an.
Egzanp: [0 2 *] miltipliye nimewo a nan endis 0 ak nimewo a nan endis 2.
Divizyon dwè bay nan nimewo antye sèlman.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Endis envalid yo. dwe diferan epi nan ranje 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Operasyon ki pa valab (divizyon ak zewo oswa rezilta non-entijè)

outcome.no_moves: Pa gen mouvman anplis. Rezilta pi bon: {best_value} (target: {target})
